How to Find a Passion ? 
Passion kiya ha ? 
Passion us kaam ko kehty han jis ma kisi ka interest ho ab kuch log kahein gy ky mera tu interest cricket ma bhi ha 😄 coding ma bhi 😄 aur doctor bhi ban na ha isliye biology bhi achi lagti ha tu perhai ma bhi interest ha meri trhan 
Tu kiya ye passions han ? 
Ni , Passion ye ni han lekin maximum chances han ky isi ma sy koi aik apka Passion ho . 
Ma samjhana hon ky Passion kaisy doondhy 
Maan lo apko 3 4 kaam han jo buhut pasand han 
1. Biology perhna 
2. Computer perhna 
3. Cricket khelna 
4. Traveling karna 
Tu Passion dhondny ky liye apko in 4 ma sy 1 select karna ha wo ap kaisy karein gy ma batata hon 😎 
Step 1. 
Ap wo kaam choose karein jo apko pasand han jaisy abhi hum ny examples ky liye 4 kaam choose kiye han
Step 2. 
Ab in 4 ma sy aik choose karny ky liye Ap ye follow karein : 
Step 3. 
Ab jo jo sawaal ma don ga wo in 4 ma fit karny ki koshish karni ha 😄 
Ap khud sy sawaal karein ky kiya waqii ye kaam apko pasand ha ? 
#Ans. Han 
Step 2.
 Ap khud sy aik aur sawaal karein ky is kaam ma apko kitna interest ha ? Isko aisy samjhein Ap is ky liye kitna motivated rehty han . Ap isy non stop kitna waqt kar sakty han ? 
#Ans. Buhut ziada aur nonstop kaafi waqt kar sakta hon jaisy 6 7 hours tak easily 
Step 3. 
Ab jab Ap khud sy 2 sawaalon ky jawaab ly lein tu teesra sawaal karein ky konsa kaam ha jis ma main itna magan hojata hon ky brain usi ma full focused rehta ha ky khana bhi khana bhool jata hon ? 
#Science proof :
Science ky hisaab sy wo kaam jis ma Ap itna kho jaty han ky apko khana khana bhi bhool jaye wo apka Passion ho sakta ha
#Ans. Mujhy Computer ky baary ma highly interest ha aur usi ma hi ma nonstop 6 7 ghanty sy ziada bhi kar sakta hon bagair boring hwy aur is ma jab ma coding karta hon aur new new program wagaira banata hon tu itna deep interest hota ha ky khana khana bhool jata hon ya dil ni karta ky khana kha lon aur time wasting lagta ha 😘. 
Step 4 :
Agar apny dhoondh Liya ky pichly sawaalon ma sy apko konsa kaam sab sy ziada fit lagta ha tu maximum chances han ky  wo apka Passion hosakta ha 
Ab  Ap aik akhiri test karty han ky kiya is kaam sy mujhy earning ho saktii ha  ? 
#Ans. Han coding aur programing ma ziadi earning possible ha . 

Tu bas agar apky sab sawaalon ky jawaab ma koi 1 fit horha ha tu wahi apka Passion ha aur usi ko follow karein taky apko feel hoky Ap sahi kar rhy ho agar kahin py apko lagy ky ye mujhy boring lagta ha tu Ap kisi dosry ko bhi choose kar sakty han 😄 because according to science: "interests can be change time to time "
Means maan lo abhi apko in 4 ma interest ha aur in future koi aur 4 ma ho tu it is normal .

So I hope this blog is informative for you 🙂 agar kahin ma galat hon tu ap mujh sy raasta kar sakty han contact page per saari info apko mil jaye gii aur ap comment bhi bhyj sakty han aur 😄 agar ap waqii sahi nikly tu ma next blog ma apko thanks bhi karon ga aur galtii bhi sahi karon ga 😄 Inshallah .

Thanks for reading 📚 😀
